items.name: Rainbow Swiss chard (leaves and stems), cooked
items.preparation: sautéed or steamed until wilted, chopped

items.name: Cooking oil (implied by sautéing)
items.preparation: used for sautéing; slight sheen on leaves

scale_cues: Used the standard square white dinner plate, about 26 cm across. The chard pile covers about 8 x 10 cm in a low mound with some loose stem pieces. The scale's metal frame and the counter edge confirm the plate size.
assumptions: The red, orange and yellow stems mean this is rainbow chard, not spinach or beet greens
The chard is cooked (wilted, darkened leaves); I used about 20 kcal and 1.9 g protein per 100 g
I assumed a small amount of oil based on the slight sheen; it could also have been steamed with no fat
I didn't see any other sauces, seasonings or drinks
